name: Rocker switch, 21 x 15 mm (NCR KCD1-101F)
summary: Snap-in on/off rocker, the size on power strips. Clips into a 19.2 x 13 mm hole.
source: NCR KCD1-101F datasheet, issue 2011-10-28: bezel 21 x 15 mm and 2.5 mm thick with the rocker standing 3.5 mm above it, housing 19 x 12.8 mm reaching 13.2 mm behind the panel, 22.6 mm overall to the ends of the 4.8 mm tabs. Panel hole 19.0 x 13 mm for panels 0.6 to 1.2 mm thick, 19.2 mm for 1.2 to 2 mm and 19.4 mm for 2 to 3 mm. Many switches sold as KCD1 copy this outline, and a smaller 15 x 10.5 mm switch uses the same name.

electrical.note: Rated 10 A at 125 V AC or 6 A at 250 V AC.
